text:
Ana: Heads-up eu-north GPUs showing a steady uptick in Xid 13/45 after last week's driver/firmware push. ECC corrected counts climbing on 6 nodes. Rolling rotation proposal below.
Devon: saw it, added to dash. what's the sigma on the Xid spike? https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/gpu-health
sre-bot: alert: GPU_XID_RATE > 0.8 for cluster eu-north-gpu-pool (6h)
Mike: quick snapshot: nodes gpu-eun-12/14/19 have 4-6 XIDs in last 24h, avg latency unaffected. ECC corrected total +18.
Ana: proposed plan:
- freeze further driver pushes to eu-north
- schedule graceful drain of 6 suspect nodes in small batches (2 at a time)
- hot-swap cards where hardware telemetry shows rising ECC+Xid correlation
- fallback: roll back to previous firmware build fw-2024-11-rc3 if Xid persists after one batch
Devon: +1. can we avoid capacity pressure during week peak? what's capacity headroom for eu-north?
Julia: we've got ~30% spare on weekdays offpeak, but only ~8% during US morning. suggest schedule drains 02:00-06:00 UTC to minimize impact.
Ana: drain playbook snippet:
- cordon node: kubectl cordon node=NODE
- drain pods with --ignore-daemonsets and --delete-local-data
- set pool state=maintenance in infra tool
- run sensor-check: /opt/bin/gpu-health-check --node NODE --full
- collect nvml logs: /var/log/nvml/*.log.gz
Devon: add step to snapshot /var/log/persisted/gpu-metrics before reboot
Mike: on hot-swap — coordinate with oncall to do physical replacement windows, vendor SLA says 4h turnaround for replacements in eu-north region.
Ana: rollback criteria:
- next batch Xid rate > 1.2x baseline AND ECC corrected increase > 25% OR any node with SLS (soft lock) events
- if rollback triggers, stop all drains in flight and roll firmware back to fw-2024-11-rc3 across pool with canary of 1 node
Julia: can we automate detection? I can add a temporary alert rule to trigger to slack channel + runbook link.
Devon: I'll update capacity reservations to reserve 15% extra for the window and post ETA in #eng-oncall
Ana: will start coordinator thread for schedule. targeting first batch tonight 02:30 UTC.
sre-bot: deploy job queued: gpu-stability-probe-run for batch 1 at 02:30 UTC
Mike: ping me 30 mins before physical swap, I'll page ops vendor.
Ana: thanks. I'll attach results after batch 1. :thumbsup:
